body: The sandwich is untouched, but the cup is half empty and its lip is coated with spray dust from the field. A handkerchief beneath it has dried brown flecks, and a withered corn leaf is folded in it.
title: The field lunch

body: One work boot has damp field clay in its seams. Its mate is still packed with clean newspaper, as if its owner went out in one borrowed boot.
title: The unworn pair

body: There are fresh drops on this cloth over a smear of fertilizer dust. The dry cloth tied beside it has none.
title: The first cough at dawn

body: A lunch bowl has grain husks stuck to its rim. The unopened bread beside it was packed for the same shift.
title: The supper carried home

body: Dark treated-feed dust covers the outer sleeve of this jacket. The clean inside is pressed around a bottle with the same residue at its neck, and a scorched crop leaf is tucked in a pocket.
title: The borrowed coat

body: A full bottle is knotted to a strip of cloth already marked with brown spit. The second bottle has not been opened. A scorched leaf of seed corn lies beside them.
title: The offered water

body: The hand shovel has fresh field soil and a cloth wrapped tightly around its grip, stained green from the sprayer. A bandage has been laid out but never used.
title: The shift's last tool

body: A pinch of dark pellets has collected in the crease of this purse. The spoon beside it is bent from opening a feed sack.
title: The feed clerk's pocket

body: The cuff is crusted with pale spray granules and crushed crop leaves. A clean tissue in the pocket was never taken out.
title: The grass on the cuff

body: Soap is wet on one side and grain grit is still pressed into the glove fingers. The water bottle is nearly empty.
title: The unfinished washing
